items.title: 68427_Harry Edison oral history interview
items.q: You take a Helen Reddy, to me she's not -- you know, she's not deserving of an NBC special

ctx.x: It's a mix. It's -- you know, it doesn't jell.

No, no. Well, it doesn't sell like the people we are familiar with, you know. It's a commercial thing now, you know. And I feel so bad about the singers I know. You take a Helen Reddy, to me she's not -- you know, she's not deserving of an NBC special and here Sarah Vaughn has never had an NBC special or Ella Fitzgerald's never had a special. You know, here comes Helen Reddy, she gets a special.
